patch.value: Cursor-complete standup reporting windows: build from a certified event boundary and retain the exact next boundary

Build a standup from a certified event boundary and retain the exact next boundary so crashes or late/backdated appends do not silently skip work between time windows. Overlap check (re-run 2026-10-27): pm history events / listMutationEvents supply cursor-resumable mutation facts; pm-observer (evidence budgets), pm-context (context-pack cursor), pm-slack (outbox resume cursors) use cursors for their own domains; this package's --since/--days/--compare date windows and snapshots select periodic views. No sibling or CLI command builds standup reporting from a retained event boundary, so this adapts the core mutation cursors to standup reporting without adding another event journal. Acceptance: (1) restart after rendering produces the same packet; (2) a late append appears once in a later admitted window; (3) missing history/cursor coverage marks the report incomplete rather than empty.

value.text: CodeRabbit round on 670a543: doc focused-test count 34 -> 35 (historical 35/35 CI line unchanged). Declined the locale-independent position comparator: the pinned SDK's own compareHistoryEventPosition (node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli/dist/core/history/event-index.js) orders by ts.localeCompare, stream_id.localeCompare, then offset; compareStandupWindowPositions mirrors it, and code-unit order would diverge from the SDK's event order.

value.author: codex
value.text: CodeRabbit round on b22b66c: installedHostEnvironment now sets NODE_V8_COVERAGE to an own empty value instead of deleting it, because Node child_process copies the parent's NODE_V8_COVERAGE into a child env that lacks the key (copyProcessEnvToEnv). The new test 'installed host children never inherit the parent's counter directory' spawns a real child; with the old delete, the child received the parent's directory (fails on revert). Typecheck, lint, docstring (140) and duplication 0% pass; the full packed suite is left to CI because of host load.

value.author: codex
value.text: CodeRabbit round on ceb888c (6 findings). Fixed: (1) scan cap trips only when the window exceeds maxEvents on any page; a non-final page reaching exactly the cap keeps reading already-covered pages. New test fails on revert (0/1); the old cap test now expects capping at 3 events on page 3. (2) README: one cursor file per consumer; the raw pm history events --since cursor is timestamp-ordered and skips backdated appends, so it does not replace standup window. Both validation links now use repository URLs, because validation docs are not shipped. (3) Packed acceptance is labeled historical for 415328b. (4) Packed acceptance now also runs --no-advance --output and asserts no admission. Declined: 'read the negated flag from advance'. The real installed CLI on hosts 2026.10.27 and 2026.10.28 does not admit with --no-advance --output (no cursor file, admitted:false); the control without the flag admits. Window suites 37/37; typecheck, lint, docstring, duplication 0%, changelog pass.

value.author: codex
value.text: CodeRabbit round on 790dad6: (1) standupWindowCoverageRegressions returns no regressions for a capped scan, because streams on unread pages are unread, not regressed; the capped window is already incomplete via event_cap_exceeded. New test 'a capped scan reports no regressions…' fails on revert (0/1). (2) README and validation doc qualify the fencing guarantee: it holds with the built-in lock provider, while an extension lock_acquire override runs fence() unfenced (pinned SDK LockLease.fence doc) and must exclude or fence concurrent commits itself. Window suites 38/38; typecheck, lint, docstring, duplication 0% (after extracting twoPageJournal), changelog pass.

value.author: codex
value.text: CodeRabbit round on fcfb656. (1) The scan counts events per stream; an uncapped scan whose stream offsets are not all read (a backdated append sorted before a page already read) reports gapStreams, and the window is incomplete with stream_offset_gap instead of admitting coverage it never read (which would make later runs report cursor_coverage_missing until repair). The reasons a scan establishes live in standupWindowScanIncompleteReasons, which is unit-tested on every branch. The pinned public replay at 57cc37a (1,099 events incl. history_redact/repair) has no gaps and stays complete, at 15,036 bytes. (2) README: one cursor file and one output file per consumer, because the lease is keyed by the cursor file; the losing-reporter guarantee applies to reporters sharing a cursor. Window suites 39/39; typecheck, lint, docstring, duplication 0%, changelog pass.

value.author: codex
value.text: CodeRabbit round on 272aa63 (3 minor). (1) The corpus is read after the journal scan, so a mutation between them lands in a later window instead of being admitted with a stale row. New test: a peer closes the item right after the corpus read, and the close then appears in the next window with the item done. It fails with the old order (0/1). (2) writeError takes the command label; standup window --output failures now say 'standup window: could not write'. The delivery-failure test asserts the label and fails on revert (0/1). (3) README: stdout is TOON (JSON with --json), but the --output file is always pretty-printed JSON. Window suites 40/40 (units and runtime-export also pass, 133 total); typecheck, lint, docstring, duplication 0% (after extracting admittedInProgressItem), changelog pass.

value.author: codex
value.text: CodeRabbit round on d4a0784 (major, a regression from my reorder): with the scan now first, invalid history reached the SDK reader before the corpus's verified-history read and surfaced as a raw SDK error instead of history_unavailable. Fix: only the SDK page read is wrapped, so a history read or verification failure is ProgressRefusal('history_unavailable') (the package's single safe refusal), while the scan's own window_* refusals keep their codes; there is no conditional branch. New test: an appended malformed history line refuses the window with history_unavailable; it fails on revert (0/1). Window suites 41/41; typecheck, lint, docstring, duplication 0% and changelog pass.
